data.one_liner: Flutter library for displaying calendar events in multiple day view layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized widgets to render daily calendar events in formats like multi-column, category, overflow, event-only, and in-row views. Includes visual customization via DayViewDecoration, auto-scrolling to current time, and interactive time slot tapping.
use_when: You need to display daily schedule or calendar events in a Flutter application
You want support for Google Calendar-style multi-column layout for overlapping events
avoid_when: You need month or year calendar views instead of a day view
You require a complex backend-synced calendar architecture out-of-the-box
strengths: Multiple layout view types including multi-column and category day views
Reusable DayViewDecoration for consistent styling across different views
Auto-scroll to current time and custom overlap strategies
weaknesses: Focused exclusively on day views rather than full month or year calendars
Recent major version updates introduce breaking changes to config and decoration structures
